// Support & FAQ

Questions, answered clearly.

Everything you need to know about Nexora, billing, security, and team support.

Still need help?

Our team can help you choose the right plan or answer product questions.

Contact support
Is there a free trial available?

Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features so you can evaluate if Nexora is the right fit for your team. No credit card required.

Can I change my plan later?

Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your workspace settings.

What is your cancellation policy?

You can cancel anytime. Your workspace stays active until the end of your current billing period.

Do you offer custom enterprise plans?

Yes. Enterprise plans can include custom SLAs, dedicated support, SSO, and priority onboarding.

How secure is my data?

We use encryption for data at rest and in transit, plus regular security reviews and access controls.
